crossrefs.text: The fire on the altar shall be kept burning; it must not be extinguished. Every morning the priest is to add wood to the fire, arrange the burnt offering on it, and burn the fat portions of the peace offerings on it.

You are to make for Me an altar of earth, and sacrifice on it your burnt offerings and peace offerings, your sheep and goats and cattle. In every place where I cause My name to be remembered, I will come to you and bless you.
Then he sent out some young men of Israel, and they offered burnt offerings and sacrificed young bulls as peace offerings to the LORD.
You are to present the bull at the front of the Tent of Meeting, and Aaron and his sons are to lay their hands on its head.
Take all the fat that covers the entrails and the lobe of the liver, and both kidneys with the fat on them, and burn them on the altar.

They must be holy to their God and not profane the name of their God. Because they present to the LORD the food offerings, the food of their God, they must be holy.
“Say to Aaron, ‘For the generations to come, none of your descendants who has a physical defect may approach to offer the food of his God.
Take the fat from the ram, the fat tail, the fat covering the entrails, the lobe of the liver, both kidneys with the fat on them, and the right thigh (since this is a ram for ordination),
“Speak to the Israelites and tell them: When any of you brings an offering to the LORD, you may bring as your offering an animal from the herd or the flock.
And he shall slaughter the young bull before the LORD, and Aaronʼs sons the priests are to present the blood and splatter it on all sides of the altar at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
If, however, oneʼs offering is a burnt offering from the flock—from the sheep or goats—he is to present an unblemished male.
He shall slaughter it on the north side of the altar before the LORD, and Aaronʼs sons the priests are to splatter its blood against the altar on all sides.
“If oneʼs offering is a peace offering and he offers an animal from the herd, whether male or female, he must present it without blemish before the LORD.
But you must not eat meat with its lifeblood still in it.
This is My blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many for the forgiveness of sins.
But you must not eat the blood; pour it on the ground like water.
“Speak to the Israelites and say, ‘You are not to eat any of the fat of an ox, a sheep, or a goat.
Only be sure not to eat the blood, because the blood is the life, and you must not eat the life with the meat.
